paragraph: The Granville composite registers at a cautious 44 out of 100 with no active breadth divergence warnings, setting a neutral-to-defensive tone for the morning session. Underlying internal pressures are acute, highlighted by a massive 55.51% surge in volatility that pushes the VIX to an elevated 25.83 alongside a backwardated term structure and front-loaded fear skew of +4.4 points. This extreme risk-off sentiment is reinforced by heavy sector damage from bellwether semis trailing the S&P 500 by -7.32% and a defensive XLP/XLY rotation up 3.55%, even as underlying high-yield credit spreads hold steady at a tight 3.32%. Despite underlying resilience in equal-weight breadth and transport leadership, the severe compression in risk appetite and aggressive volatility pricing dominate the tape. Expect a choppy session with a downward directional lean as traders aggressively price in immediate fear.
